3GPP TSG-RAN WG3#98 R3-174997 Reno, NV, USA, 27 November-1 December 2017 3GPP TSG-SA WG5 Meeting #116 Tdoc S5-176477 Reno, US, 27 November - 1 December 2017. Title: LS reply on support of Trace and MDT in NG-RAN in rel-15 Response to: LS S5-176048 / R3-173422 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: SA5 To: RAN3, CT4 Cc: RAN2 Contact Person: Name: Anatoly Andrianov Tel. Number: - E-mail Address: anatoly <dot> andrianov <at> nokia <dot> com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: None 1. Overall Description: SA5 discussed the support for Trace and MDT in Rel-15 for 5G including NG-RAN and 5G Core. A new SA5 Rel-15 work item to address 5G Trace aspects including use cases, requirements, activation/deactivation mechanisms, control and configuration parameters, trace record definitions has been agreed in SA5 and is pending SA approval. Impacted SA5 specifications are TSs 32.421, 32.422. 32.423 and 32.44x series. The support for MDT and SON in NG-RAN and 5G Core is targeted to be addressed in Rel-16. 2. Actions: To RAN3 and CT4 groups. ACTION: SA5 asks RAN3 and CT4 groups to take the information above into account. 3. Date of Next TSG-SA WG5 Meetings: SA5#117 29 January - 2 February 2018 Rome, Italy SA5#118 9-13 April 2018 Beijing, China

3GPP TSG-RAN WG3#98 R3-174937 Reno, NV, USA, 27 November-1 December 2017 3GPP TSG-RAN WG2 #100 Tdoc R2-1714129 Reno, Nevada, USA, 27th November – 1st December 2017 Title: LS on TDM pattern coordination for single UL operation Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: RAN2 To: RAN3 Contact Person: Name: Haijing Hu Tel. Number: +86 18612683085 E-mail Address: haijing_hu@apple.com 1. Overall Description: RAN2 has discussed TDM pattern coordination for single UL operation for EN-DC. As conclusion, RAN2 assumes that RAN3 will progress the topic of TDM pattern coordination for single UL operation. RAN2 also suggests to RAN3 that the TDM pattern for single UL operation is realized with a BITMAP with 40ms periodicity and 1ms subframe granularity, which applies to both case 1 and case 2. It is up to RAN3 to define the signaling and whether the same mechanism is used to address the harmonic issue. Case 1 and case 2 can be referred to the following RAN1 agreements made in RAN1#90. 2. Actions: To RAN3 group: ACTION: RAN2 kindly requests RAN3 to take above into account when designing the related signalling for TDM pattern coordination. 3. Date of Next RAN2 Meetings: RAN2#NR Ad hoc-1801 22nd – 26th January 2018 Vancouver, Canada RAN2#101 26th February – 2nd March 2018 Athens, Greece

3GPP TSG RAN WG3 Meeting #128 R3-253853 Malta, MT, 19 - 23 May, 2025 3GPP TSG-RAN WG2 Meeting #130 R2-2504847 St Julian’s, Malta, May 19th – 23rd, 2025 Title: Reply LS on emergency call back and paging Response to: S2-2502427 / R2-2501752 Release: Rel-17 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core, NR_redcap-Core Source: RAN2 To: SA2, RAN3 Cc: CT1 Contact person: Jing Liu liu.jing30@zte.com.cn Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: None 1. Overall Description: RAN2 thanks SA2 for the reply LS on emergency service call back and paging. RAN2 further discussed this issue and confirm the feasibility of the solution mentioned in reply LS, that RAN can be aware of emergency PDU session based on the reserved ARP value. In addition to the endorsed solution from RAN3 (i.e. the gNB should not configure eDRX for RAN paging when releasing the UE to RRC_INACTIVE state), RAN2 also agreed that no new UE behavior will be specified for this case. It is up to the gNB implementation whether to release the UE to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or keep the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state for fast emergency callback. 2. Actions: To SA2, RAN3 group: ACTION: RAN2 kindly requests SA2 and RAN3 to take the above information into account. 3. Date of Next RAN2 Meetings: RAN2#131 25th – 29th Aug 2025 India, IN RAN2#131bis 13th – 17th Oct 2025 Prague, CZ

3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 Meeting #127-bis R3-251899 Wuhan, China, 7-11 April, 2025 Title: [Draft] Reply LS on emergency call back and paging Response to: LS S2-2502427 / R3-251521 on emergency call back and paging Release: Rel-17 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core, NR_redcap-Core Source: Huawei [to be RAN3] To: SA2 Cc: RAN2, CT1 Contact person: Feng Han Hanfeng3@huawei.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: None 1 Overall description RAN3 thanks SA2 and RAN2 for their LS on emergency call back and paging. RAN3 discussed the RAN eDRX issue for RRC inactive UE. RAN3 understood that key issue was whether emergency PDU session could be deactivated at the CN, and the candidate solution would be dependent on such decision. RAN3 would like to provide the following thinking for emergency PDU session from RAN3 perspective: the RAN eDRX should be treated the same as idle eDRX, i.e., both configured, or neither configured in case of emergency PDU session; a unified solution for eDRX, PEI, LP-WUS should be considered to ease the RAN handling complexities. 2 Actions To SA2/RAN2: ACTION: RAN3 respectfully asks SA2/RAN2 to take above information into account when considering the next step for emergency PDU session. 3 Dates of next RAN3 meetings Updated meeting schedule can be found at: https://portal.3gpp.org/?tbid=373&SubTB=381#/ RAN3#128 2025-05-19 - 2025-05-23 Malta, MT RAN3#129 2025-08-25 - 2025-08-29 Bangalore, IN RAN3#129-bis 2025-10-13 - 2025-10-17 Prague, CZ RAN3#130 2025-11-17 - 2025-11-21 Dallas, US

3GPP TSG RAN WG3 Meeting #129 R3-255883 Bangalore, India, Aug 25th – 29th , 2025 Title: Reply LS on emergency call back and paging Response to: Reply LS on emergency call back and paging (S2-2505938/ R3-255022) Release: Rel-17 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core, NR_redcap-Core Source: RAN WG3 To: SA WG2 CC: RAN2, CT1, TSG RAN Contact person: Prasad Kadiri pkadiri@qti.qualcomm.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: None 1 Overall description RAN3 would like to thank SA2 for the “Reply LS on emergency call back and paging”. Regarding the SA2 questions, RAN3 has further discussed and provides the following responses. Question 1： Is it possible to have different behavior in NG-RAN node depending on the presence of the emergency PDU session to decide when to release RRC connection, compared to when there is no emergency PDU session? RAN3 Answer: On the presence of the emergency PDU session, it is up to NG-RAN node implementation whether to release or maintain the UE RRC connection. Question 2: If yes, when the emergency PDU session exists, whether it is required to configure the NG-RAN to not release RRC connection until the emergency PDU session is released by the SMF? 3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 Meeting #129 R3-255236 Bengaluru, India, 25th - 29th Aug, 2025 Title: [draft] Reply LS on emergency call back and paging Response to: LS R3-255022/S2-2505938 on emergency call back and paging Release: Rel-17 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core, NR_redcap-Core Source: Huawei [to be RAN3] To: SA2 Cc: RAN2, CT1 Contact person: Feng Han Hanfeng3@huawei.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: None 1 Overall description RAN3 thanks SA2 and RAN2 for their subsequent LS on emergency call back and paging. Regarding the questions raised by SA2 below, RAN3 would like to provide following answers. Q1： Is it possible to have different behaviour in NG-RAN node depending on the presence of the emergency PDU session to decide when to release RRC connection, compared to when there is no emergency PDU session? RAN3 Answer: it is left unspecified whether to have different NG-RAN behavior to release or suspend the RRC connection when there is emergency PDU session, that is, it is up to NG-RAN implementation. Q2: If yes, when the emergency PDU session exist, whether it is required to configure the NG-RAN to not release RRC connection until the emergency PDU session is released by the SMF? RAN3 Answer: Given the reply to Q1, there is no such requirement. 2 Actions To SA2: ACTION: RAN3 respectfully asks to take above information into account. 3 Dates of next RAN3 meetings Updated meeting schedule can be found at: https://portal.3gpp.org/?tbid=373&SubTB=381#/ RAN3#129-bis 2025-10-13 - 2025-10-17 Prague, CZ RAN3#130 2025-11-17 - 2025-11-21 Dallas, US

3GPP TSG-RAN WG3#100 R3-182564 Busan, South Korea, 21-25 May 2018 3GPP TSG SA2 Meeting 127 TDoc S2-184498 Sanya, China 16-20 April 2018 Title: LS on clarification of NSSAI information exchange during Inactive to connected mode transition Response to: LS R2-1804107 on clarification of NSSAI information exchange during Inactive to connected mode transition from RAN2 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core, 5GS_Ph1-CT Source: SA2 To: RAN2, CT1 Cc: RAN3 Contact person: Alessio Casati Alessio.Casati@nokia.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org 1 Overall description SA2 would like to thank RAN2 for informing about an agreement on inclusion of NSSAI during RRC connection establishment and involving SA2 in the discussion on inclusion of NSSAI during transition from RRC_INACTIVE state to RRC_CONNECTED state. RAN2's question: RAN2 would kindly request CT1 to answer the question whether NAS layer in UE provide NSSAI information during transition from RRC_INACTIVE state to RRC_CONNECTED state? SA2's feedback: It is SA2 view that the NSSAI is not included in the Resume Procedure. 2 Actions To RAN2, CT1 ACTION: Please take the above into account 3 Dates of next SA2 meetings
